Campaign strategy

The campaign moves members through four stages: vote, register, prepare, and complete the exam. Use the poll to identify the preferred certification path, then switch to the appropriate result announcement and registration sequence.

Campaign theme: Two Fabric certification paths. Thirty exam vouchers. One community helping people get ready.

Confirmed campaign facts

  • 30 exam vouchers, approximately $165 each
  • Register for the exam by October 31, 2026
  • Take the exam by November 30, 2026
  • Split vote: two 3-hour sessions for each certification
  • Clear winner: four 1.5-hour sessions for the winner
  • Instructors lead Data Days study groups and Reactor Series certification-prep sessions

Poll launch

Launch the Vote

FP
Fabric & Power BI Insurance User GroupCommunity announcement
🎓 YOU VOTE. WE STUDY. YOU CERTIFY.

The Fabric & Power BI Insurance User Group is planning its next community certification study group, and you get to choose the path:

🟢 DP-600: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer
🔵 DP-700: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer

We also have 30 certification exam vouchers, each worth approximately $165, to help motivate members to take the next step.

How the study-group format will work:
• If the vote is split, we will offer two 3-hour DP-600 sessions and two 3-hour DP-700 sessions.
• If one certification wins decisively, we will offer four 1.5-hour sessions for the winner.

Our instructors are seasoned professionals who lead study groups during Data Days and certification-prep sessions for the Reactor Series.

Vote in the poll, then tell us in the comments what made you choose your path.

Choose Your Path

FP
Fabric & Power BI Insurance User GroupCommunity announcement
DP-600 or DP-700? Let’s make the decision a little easier.

Choose DP-600 if your work leans toward analytics solutions, semantic models, warehouses, lakehouses, SQL, KQL, DAX, and turning trusted data into business insight.

Choose DP-700 if your work leans toward data loading and transformation, data architectures, pipelines, orchestration, lakehouses, SQL, PySpark, KQL, and monitoring data solutions.

Both are strong paths. The best choice is the one that helps you build the skills you want to use next.

Copy-ready creative direction

Image-generation prompt library

Each prompt is written as a complete text block for direct use in Microsoft Copilot or another image-generation tool. Use the matching LinkedIn post as the caption, and generate both square and landscape variations where useful.

Image prompt 1

Campaign Launch: DP-600 vs. DP-700

Use with the poll-launch post

Create a polished LinkedIn campaign image for the Fabric & Power BI Insurance User Group. Theme: “You Vote. We Study. You Certify.” Show two friendly, modern certification-path characters or cards facing one another in a positive competition: DP-600 on the left in teal/green and DP-700 on the right in blue/cobalt. Include subtle Microsoft Fabric-inspired ribbon shapes, data bars, semantic model nodes, lakehouse and pipeline motifs, and a professional insurance-data atmosphere. Add a clear visual badge representing 30 certification exam vouchers. Business-casual, upbeat, credible, and community-focused rather than cartoonish. Use a navy, teal, cobalt, gold, and white palette. High contrast, clean hierarchy, premium conference-marketing style, inclusive and professional. No Microsoft logo and no copied certification badge artwork. Leave room for a short headline to be added later. No small text, no paragraphs, no watermarks, no distorted symbols. Landscape 1200 x 627 composition, no empty space.
Image prompt 2
